skills.title: weekly review
skills.body:
# weekly review

1. list what i wrote this week, by area.
2. name the decisions made and the questions still open.
3. pick one thing to drop.

cite every claim.

skills.title: what did i reject
skills.body:
# what did i reject

find every rejection in the last six months. for each: what i chose instead, and whether i still agree.

skills.title: questions still open
skills.body:
# questions still open

list open questions older than a month, oldest first, with the note that raised each.

skills.title: a letter from the archive
skills.body:
# a letter from the archive

choose one note from a year ago today and write me a short letter about what has changed since.

skills.title: latent links
skills.body:
# latent links

for the note in front of me, find three older notes it already agrees with, and one it quietly contradicts.
